chunks: Maʿrūf ibn Kharrabūdh narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has paired zakat with salat (prayer), and so He said:
So whoever establishes salat (prayer) but does not give zakat (alms-tax), it is as though he has not established salat (prayer)."

key_terms.آتُوا: give or pay what is due
key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat (alms-tax), the obligatory financial due paired with salat
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the prescribed act of worship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the connection between salat and zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah has joined zakat with salat (prayer), showing that both are inseparable obligations in religious practice. It emphasizes that neglecting zakat undermines the value of one’s salat, highlighting the central place of financial duty alongside worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1584 - Ma'ruf ibn Kharrabudh reports from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has paired Zakat with prayer, as He said:
(Surah Al Baqarah 2:43). Therefore, whoever establishes prayer but does not give Zakat, it is as though he has not established prayer."
